title: 台风夜老宅
subject: 化学
voteQuestion: 谁的行为直接导致了本次浴室暴露事故？
background: 台风夜，老宅内发生浴室暴露事故。伤者余老师于当晚进入浴室后出现异常，随后被发现。学生需在老宅场景中搜集线索、问询人物并完成化学分析，指认直接致因者。（正式美术与完整剧情由组员提供；本配置为可玩骨架。）
briefing: 投票问题关注“直接导致暴露事故”的行为，不表述为故意杀人或法律责任判决。
科学结论须严谨：pH、显色、ppm 等不能被过度解读。
危险环境取样以预先取得的模拟报告展示，不要求学生闻气味或进入危险操作。

en.title: The Typhoon-Night Old House
en.subject: Chemistry
en.voteQuestion: Whose action directly caused this bathroom exposure incident?
en.background: On a typhoon night, a bathroom exposure incident occurred in an old house. The injured person, Teacher Yu, entered the bathroom that evening, then became unwell and was found soon after. Students gather clues in the house, question the people involved, finish a chemistry analysis, and name the person whose action directly caused the exposure. (Final art and the full script come from the team; this config is a playable skeleton.)
briefing: The vote is about the action that directly caused the exposure. It is not a finding of intentional harm or a legal verdict.
Scientific conclusions must stay careful: pH, color tests, and ppm must not be over-read.
Sampling in a hazardous setting is shown through pre-collected mock reports. Students are not asked to smell anything or perform a dangerous procedure.
TODO: names, evidence IDs, and the test subject in the official script, field guide, and revision list should replace this skeleton after the team confirms them.

C-E01.name: Incident timeline
C-E01.studentText: Teacher Yu entered the bathroom at 23:30; an unusual sound at 23:38; found at 23:42. Injured person: Teacher Yu.

C-E02.name: Cleaner-bottle label fragments
C-E02.studentText: Empty bottles or residue of a suspected acid cleaner and a chlorine cleaner were in the same area. Placement alone does not prove they were mixed.

C-E03.name: Corridor trace
C-E03.studentText: There is a pale powdery trace on the floor. Whether it contacted the injured person needs more evidence. — TODO: shoe-powder test details still to be confirmed.

C-E04.name: First screen of the cup residue
C-E04.studentText: pH about 3, which supports that the sample is acidic. This alone cannot identify citric acid or judge how strong the acid is.

C-E05.name: Medicine-related test (disputed)
C-E05.studentText: [TODO / conflict] The script and the web page must not mix the “tablet test” with the “alcohol-wipe test”. This card is only a placeholder until the team agrees on the official subject. A color result alone cannot prove expiry or a health effect.

C-E06.name: Mixed residue in the bathroom
C-E06.studentText: The sample point shows residue features compatible with mixed cleaners (skeleton description). The exposure path still needs the ventilation and the timeline.

C-E07.name: Oxidizer first screen (P5)
C-E07.studentText: The oxidizer first screen is positive (skeleton). Keep it separate from a mock recheck that would support chlorine gas. Do not jump to a qualitative conclusion in one step.

C-E08.name: Concentration estimate note (P6)
C-E08.studentText: The model estimate of about 105 ppm is an ideal-model value, not a field measurement, and it does not by itself decide the injury. When you use the 10 ppm reference, say what it means. It is not the only safety boundary.
